# Download single cell data

```
Download the Mareckova & Garcia-Alonso et al 2023 endometrium reference 
integrated atlas (all cells dataset) from 
https://www.reproductivecellatlas.org/endometrium_reference.html
and store as `data/endometriumAtlasV2_cells_with_counts.h5ad`.
```

-----

# Load

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(MuSiC)
library(Seurat)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(anndata)
```

```{r}
GSE234354_counts <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_counts.rds"))
GSE234354_phenotype <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_phenotype.rds"))
GSE234354_gene_annotations <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_gene_annotations.rds"))
methyl_phenotype <- readRDS(here("data/methyl_phenotype.rds"))
```


-----

# Load in single cell data

```{r}
cell_lineage_output <- here("cache/rwh_cell_prop_lineage.rds")
load_data <- ! file.exists(cell_lineage_output)
```


```{r}
if (load_data) {
  message("Loading in single cell data")
  data <- read_h5ad(here("data/endometriumAtlasV2_cells_with_counts.h5ad"))
  data <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = t(data$X), meta.data = data$obs)
  gc()
  data_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(data)
  rm(data)
  gc() 
} else {
  message("Deconvolution already done. Will load files from cache.")  
}
```


# MuSiC deconvolution on RWH samples

```{r}
annotation <- GSE234354_gene_annotations[!duplicated(GSE234354_gene_annotations$symbol),]
dim(annotation)
```

```{r}
counts <- GSE234354_counts[annotation$ensembl_id,]
rownames(counts) <- annotation$symbol
head(counts, 5:6)
```

```{r}
dim(counts)
```


## Lineage

```{r}
if (file.exists(cell_lineage_output)) {
  message("Deconvolution already done. Loading results from cache.")
  est_prop_lineage <- readRDS(cell_lineage_output)
} else {
  cell_types <- levels(data_sce$lineage)
  est_prop_lineage <- music_prop(bulk.mtx = counts, sc.sce = data_sce, clusters = "lineage",
                                   samples = "sample", select.ct = cell_types, verbose = TRUE)
  saveRDS(est_prop_lineage, file=cell_lineage_output)
  gc()
}
```


-----

# Save phenotype data


```{r}
cell_lineage_df <- data.frame(est_prop_lineage$Est.prop.weighted) %>%
  clean_names() %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id")
colnames(cell_lineage_df)[-1] <- paste0("cl_", colnames(cell_lineage_df)[-1])

methyl_phenotype_with_cell_props <- methyl_phenotype %>%
  left_join(GSE234354_phenotype %>% select(sample_id, batch) %>%
              dplyr::rename(rna_batch="batch"), by=join_by(sample_id)) %>%
  left_join(cell_lineage_df, by=join_by(sample_id))
```

```{r}
methyl_phenotype_with_cell_props
```

```{r}
saveRDS(methyl_phenotype_with_cell_props,
        file=here("data/methyl_phenotype_with_cell_props.rds"))
```
